module.purpose: Provide the useSuspenseQueries hook for Preact Query that wraps useQueries with suspense-enforced defaults and exports recursive type utilities for inferring query/result tuples.
module.summary: This module implements a Preact hook for running multiple queries with React Suspense support. It delegates to the core useQueries hook but maps each provided query option to force suspense mode, a default throwOnError handler, enabled state, and cleared placeholder data. It also defines TypeScript type aliases that recursively unwrap arrays of query options to infer and enforce parameter and result types, with a depth limit to avoid compiler recursion errors. In development, it logs an error if skipToken is supplied as a query function.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query for Preact; enables suspense-based parallel data fetching. Failure breaks suspense queries or causes dev-time misuse to go unnoticed.

detail.name: useSuspenseQueries
detail.signature: export function useSuspenseQueries(options: any, queryClient?: QueryClient)
preconditions: options must be an object containing a queries property that is an array
postconditions: Returns the result of useQueries with each query augmented to have suspense: true, throwOnError: defaultThrowOnError, enabled: true, placeholderData: undefined
invariants: Every query in the transformed queries array has suspense set to true and enabled set to true
edgeCases: When query.queryFn === skipToken and process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production', console.error is called with a warning but the query is still transformed normally
If options.queries is an empty array, useQueries is called with an empty queries array

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If options.queries is not an array, a TypeError is thrown by Array.prototype.map

detail.summary: Wraps useQueries to force all provided queries into suspense mode with enabled true and default error throwing, issuing a development-only warning if skipToken is used as a query function.

specTests.then: console.error is called with 'skipToken is not allowed for useSuspenseQueries' and the returned value's queries[0] has suspense: true, enabled: true, placeholderData: undefined, throwOnError: defaultThrowOnError
